query: SELECT t.type_name AS vehicle_type, SUM(v.load_capacity) AS total_load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY t.type_name
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.shipping_company GROUP BY status;
SELECT LEFT(area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '32%' GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,4);
